name: [UPD] 🦠 Parasite.exe
desc:
Welcome to the Parasite Testing, where your experiments come to life.
Create and release parasites, watch them grow, and see how they infect and spawn strange organisms inside the test chambers. Every parasite behaves differently—some evolve, some spread, and some become completely uncontrollable.

🎉UPDATE 8: 
- ⚔️ Parasite 1v1
- 📋  Contracts
- 🧬 New Parasite features
- 🎞️ New Parasite Growing animation
- ⚙️ Game optimization


Spawn and test different parasite presets
Watch parasites grow, spread, and infect the lab
Experiment with destruction, doors, and mutations
Open Alpha: new parasite types and features added often!-
Can you survive what you create… or will the Parasite take over?
